reason: Every element of the claim checks out. (1) 2025 roster: the cited AUS article (dated 6 November 2025, event 1-2 November 2025 at the AUS Main Building) states verbatim "First place went to team Hayyakum, comprising Mahmoud Darwish, Amr Mohi Aldeen, Mohamad Dabbagh and Afif Zughayer"; the independent Sharjah24 report of the same date (https://sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2025/11/06/Innovation-Hackathon-reimagines-tourism-experience-at-AUS) carries the identical sentence. Neither article names any mentors, and neither mentions ReteIntel or Amana Vision. (2) 2026 mentors: the project brief D:\Sharjah Tourism Hackathon\00_Hackathon_Brief.md (section 7, compiled 10 October 2026 from the organizer emails of Ali Reza Sajun, AUS CSE, and the Mentor Profiles deck) lists "Afif Zughayer | Founder, Amana Vision" and "Mahmoud Darwish | Founder, ReteIntel" among eight mentors for the 10-11 October 2026 event at the AUS Main Building, organized by the AUS Department of Computer Science and Engineering with SCTDA as partner. The spellings match the 2025 article exactly. No public web page lists the 2026 mentors, so this part rests on the organizer documents only; the Mentor Profiles deck itself is not on disk. (3) Affiliations: web searches for "ReteIntel", "Amana Vision" (UAE/Sharjah), "Afif Zughayer", and "Mahmoud Darwish" + ReteIntel returned nothing relevant (only Retelit, Amana Healthcare, Al Amana Optics, and the poet Mahmoud Darwish), so "could not be verified online" is accurate. (4) Timing: the two events are about eleven months apart (1-2 November 2025 to 10-11 October 2026), so "one year later" is a slight rounding. One caveat on the inference: "Mahmoud Darwish" is a very common name, so the strength of the match comes from both names co-occurring on both lists, especially the rare surname Zughayer, not from either name alone.
corrected_claim: Two mentors listed for the 10-11 October 2026 Sharjah Tourism Innovation Hackathon at AUS, Mahmoud Darwish (Founder, ReteIntel) and Afif Zughayer (Founder, Amana Vision), share exact names with two of the four members of Hayyakum, the first-place team at the 1-2 November 2025 edition ("comprising Mahmoud Darwish, Amr Mohi Aldeen, Mohamad Dabbagh and Afif Zughayer", https://www.aus.edu/media/news/sharjah-tourism-innovation-hackathon-at-aus-reimagines-travel-and-tourism-experience, confirmed independently at https://sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2025/11/06/Innovation-Hackathon-reimagines-tourism-experience-at-AUS). Neither ReteIntel nor Amana Vision could be found online, and the 2026 mentor list exists only in the organizer documents, but the co-occurrence of both names, including the rare surname Zughayer, in an AUS-run event roughly eleven months later makes the match strong.
